name: opencode-go-worker
description: Let Claude hand off well-specified, verifiable work to OpenCode Go models as a flat-rate worker, with allowance usage in the status line.

api_key.title: OpenCode Console API key
api_key.description: A Console key (oc_sk_...) from a workspace subscribed to Go. Stored in secure storage. Leave empty to use ~/.config/opencode-go/api_key (readable only by you). Environment variables are not read.

default_model.title: Default model
default_model.description: Model id used when Claude leaves model empty. Run go_models to see what your plan offers.

allow_outside_workdir.title: Skip the file permission check
allow_outside_workdir.description: Off by default: `files` and `output_path` may only use paths Claude Code lets Claude Read / Write (working folder, scratchpad, /add-dir folders), and never files a deny rule blocks.

explore_agent.title: Read-only explore subagent (experimental)
explore_agent.description: Registers a read-only subagent (Read, Grep, Glob) whose model requests go to OpenCode Go instead of Claude.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the status line and /go-usage: auto (your system language, English if it can't be told), en or ko. Prompts and tool text the model reads are always English.
